history.summary: Plan completed and committed (56d1ba6). The task shape is cross-cutting, with nine phases across AnsibleSpecs, Architecture, JenkinsPipelineUtils, ArgoCDDeploy (the native registry, then a hand-over gated by one setting) and Ansible (the switch runbook, argo-migrate, recommend-resources, docs). attachments/registry-switch.md defines the switch protocol, verification.json holds 23 criteria, and the close-out has four out-of-scope suggestions. One ruling's premise is wrong: ArgoCDDeploy has no relay webhook today (its only hook goes to Jenkins), so the switch runbook adds one as an operator step.

Plan is structurally sound (ACs map 1:1 to R1-R7, every Target resolves, citations hold), but two blocking findings: P9/V18 describe ArgoCDDeploy's registry as live although Argo reads HelmCharts' until the operator's switch, with no owner for the docs across that boundary; and the rulings still carry three facts the phases contradict (the ArgoCDDeploy webhook, 41 elements, register editing release.yaml).

Fix pass committed. The fix-forward ruling removes the way back from the switch attachment, P6 and V14, and S2 no longer claims the unproven re-adoption. The docs ruling adds owed notes to the registry-dependent procedures in P9, a last runbook step that removes them in P6, and matching wording in V18 plus a new V24 owed after the switch. The second equivalence run is in P6's order and V14, and the phase text no longer chains corrections to the rulings.
